integrity: Exact matrix derivation and symbolic proof in RESULT.md; standalone SymPy and NumPy script verifies an admissible ten-node instance. No independent audit or exhaustive historical-priority claim.
scientific_limitations: Fixed stable disease-free information equilibrium; infection invasion is linear, not a nonlinear extinction or endemicity theorem. The explicit reentrant example uses the stable all-unaware state with no pairwise information transmission; critical equality cases are not classified.
title: A convex commuting-invasion barrier and an exact reentrant window in a two-city epidemic network
